continuationDomain.sourceRef: BOTH halves. Own-state acceptance: https://docs.cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/thought-signatures (read 2026-10-29): Vertex returns `thoughtSignature` on response parts and documents passing it back on the exact part; "Gemini 3 models enforce stricter validation ... If a required thought signature is not returned when using Gemini 3 models, the model will return a 400 error." https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/generate-content/thought-signatures (read 2026-10-29): Gemini 2.5 signatures are optional to return, Gemini 3 and 4 mandatory on function calls. The GenerateContent adapter (shared by the Gemini API and Vertex) captures each signature and replays it on its part; same-model only -- a Vertex signature is never sent to the Gemini API or the reverse. Why the domain is NARROW: the state is valid only for the model that produced it on this route -- a different model, or the same model at another provider (a different credential and account), never receives it, and the history renderer strips it there.

If this is true, thoughts are returned only when available."; https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/models/thinking (read 2026-10-05) — "Thought summaries are supported in Gemini 2.5 and later models", and this model is in that page's thinking list. The field is a BOOLEAN, recorded as its single enabling spelling, as on `vertex/gemini-2.5-pro`.

continuationDomain.sourceRef: BOTH halves. Own-state acceptance: https://docs.cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/thought-signatures (read 2026-10-29): Vertex returns `thoughtSignature` on response parts and documents passing it back on the exact part; "Gemini 3 models enforce stricter validation ... If a required thought signature is not returned when using Gemini 3 models, the model will return a 400 error." https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/generate-content/thought-signatures (read 2026-10-29): Gemini 2.5 signatures are optional to return, Gemini 3 and 4 mandatory on function calls. The GenerateContent adapter (shared by the Gemini API and Vertex) captures each signature and replays it on its part; same-model only -- a Vertex signature is never sent to the Gemini API or the reverse. Why the domain is NARROW: the state is valid only for the model that produced it on this route -- a different model, or the same model at another provider (a different credential and account), never receives it, and the history renderer strips it there.

replayScope.sourceRef: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/generate-content/thought-signatures (read 2026-10-29): "Strict validation is enforced for all function calls within the current turn. (Only current turn is required; we don't validate on previous turns)"

toolLoopRequirement.sourceRef: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/generate-content/thought-signatures (read 2026-10-29): "When using Gemini 4 and Gemini 3 models, you must pass back thought signatures during function calling, otherwise you will get a validation error (4xx status code)"; "Function call `FC1` in the `1.` content block is missing a `thought_signature`"
